chapters.title: 5-Minute KAIROS Quick Start
chapters.purpose: Learn the core loop: discover destinations, check phenology, simulate lighting, and plan trips.
chapters.entry: Launch the 3D globe from the home page; use the top island bar and right drawer.
steps: Zoom/rotate the 3D globe or click continent pills to fly smoothly
Filter peak months (4-5 star suitability) from the top bar
Select any destination marker to inspect 5,414 curated photo spots
Click "Add to Trip" to launch the Multimodal Trip Planner
chapters.example: Search "Kyoto" -> pick April Tier-C bloom -> preview Kiyomizu-dera SunCalc -> add to a 4-day trip.
chapters.issues: 3D globe requires WebGL2; switch tile routes in Layers if tiles load slowly.
chapters.limits: Core globe works offline/guest-only; multi-user cloud sync requires sign-in.

chapters.title: KAIROS Philosophy & Ephemeris Precision
chapters.purpose: Understand "Right place, exact astronomical window" and scientific transparency.
chapters.entry: Available from Story Prologue and source badges across modules.
steps: Astronomy badge = deterministic orbital ephemeris
Realtime badge = live telemetry/forecasts <=14 days
Empirical badge = curated atlas & historical climatology
chapters.example: 60 days ahead keeps exact solar azimuths while excluding live weather forecasts.
chapters.issues: Historical climate normals represent multi-year averages, not single-day guarantees.
chapters.limits: Zero fabricated long-range weather predictions beyond 14 days.

chapters.title: 3D Globe Navigation & Base Skins
chapters.purpose: Master 3D camera controls and Satellite, NatGeo, Physical, and Dark base maps.
chapters.entry: Layers button in the top bar or mobile bottom navigation.
steps: Pick a base skin inside Layers popover
Right-drag or Ctrl+drag adjusts camera pitch and bearing
Zoom in to inspect 722 curated cities across 137 countries
Click compass or KAIROS home logo to reset
chapters.example: Use Dark skin for aurora/night lights and Physical skin for alpine ridges.
chapters.issues: Lower pixel ratio in Diagnostics if GPU frame rate drops.
chapters.limits: Maximum satellite zoom detail depends on public tile providers.

chapters.title: Natural-Language Search & Destination Comparison
chapters.purpose: Query by month, budget, exclusions, transit pace, and compare 2-4 cities side by side.
chapters.entry: Search pill / Cmd+K; "⚖ Compare" button in Destination Drawer.
steps: Type natural criteria like "Oct Japan rail autumn foliage no beach under $1200"
Inspect parsed filter chips and negative exclusions
Open side-by-side matrix for budgets, seasonality, and gateways
chapters.example: Inspect Kyoto -> Compare to discover similar off-peak or lower-budget matches.
chapters.issues: Separate exclusion clauses with spaces or commas for accurate parsing.
chapters.limits: Similarity uses a 10-dimension interpretable vector rather than subjective reviews.

chapters.title: Destination Drawer & Multi-Tab Inspector
chapters.purpose: Explore monthly ribbons, spots, budgets, climate normals, and Wikidata verification.
chapters.entry: Click any destination marker on the globe or gallery card.
steps: Tap any month in the 12-month phenology ribbon
Switch between Spots, Photo Sim, Months, Budget, and Local Details tabs
Mobile users can drag the sheet handle across peek, half, and full heights
chapters.example: Expand spot cards to jump directly into 3D Viewfinder or Panoramax Street View.
chapters.issues: Custom unindexed stops can still be added directly inside Trip Planner.
chapters.limits: Displayed budgets are reference tiers; confirm live prices on booking sites.

chapters.title: Three-Tier Phenology & Holdout Validation
chapters.purpose: Understand Tier A Archive, Tier B Climate-Elevation, and Tier C Calibrated models.
chapters.entry: Destination Drawer -> Months/Phenology tab.
steps: Check the Tier A/B/C badge and data provenance line
Review peak date estimates plus +/- uncertainty bounds
Switch landscape categories (blossom, autumn, snow, alpine flower, glacier)
chapters.example: 23 temperate benchmark cities report Tier C holdout MAE in days.
chapters.issues: Unusual warm springs shift actual bloom dates beyond climatological means.
chapters.limits: Tier C calibration applies strictly to the 23 benchmark cities.

chapters.title: Aurora & Space Weather Telemetry
chapters.purpose: Assess aurora probability via geomagnetic latitude, polar night, and NOAA SWPC.
chapters.entry: Layers -> Aurora Oval, or Phenology card -> Aurora tab.
steps: Enable NOAA OVATION Aurora overlay from Layers
Inspect geomagnetic latitude and monthly astronomical darkness hours
Verify both Kp activity and cloud cover before heading out
chapters.example: Tromso (~67° mag lat) peaks geometrically from late Sep through Mar.
chapters.issues: Polar summer daylight prevents aurora observation regardless of Kp.
chapters.limits: Solar storms cannot be forecast weeks or months ahead.

chapters.title: Photo Simulator & Ephemeris Clock
chapters.purpose: Compute solar azimuth, altitude curves, moonrise, and Milky Way core visibility.
chapters.entry: Drawer -> Photo Sim tab, or "Simulate" pill on any spot card.
steps: Pick a spot and date (auto-applies local IANA timezone & DST)
Scrub time or tap Dawn/Sunrise/Golden Hour presets
Rotate camera azimuth slider to evaluate Front/Side/Back lighting
Check Galactic Core elevation and moonlight percentage
chapters.example: Preview July Galactic Core altitude and moonset interference cleanly.
chapters.issues: Always verify destination DST offset displayed at top of the simulator.
chapters.limits: Polar latitudes experience continuous day/night during solstices.

chapters.title: 8-Scene Opportunity Index & Alpenglow Lead
chapters.purpose: Score 8 shooting archetypes with 14-day weather guard and peak alpenglow timing.
chapters.entry: Photo Simulator -> Photo Opportunity Index card.
steps: Pick 1 of 8 presets (Sunrise, Mountain Alpenglow, Milky Way, Architecture, etc.)
Inspect positive & negative scoring drivers
Use Action Buttons: Add Window to Trip, Save Preset, or Share/Poll
chapters.example: Dates >14 days ahead omit live weather and explain astronomy-only scoring.
chapters.issues: Distant high peaks glow several minutes before sunlight reaches lower viewpoints.
chapters.limits: 30-90m DEM grids exclude foreground trees and buildings.

chapters.title: 3D Viewfinder, Grid & Optical Crop
chapters.purpose: Frame 3D terrain using real sensor formats, focal lengths, aspect ratios, and pitch HUD.
chapters.entry: Click "3D Viewfinder" from Photo Simulator or spot cards.
steps: Select sensor, aspect ratio, and landscape/portrait framing
Toggle Rule-of-Thirds grid and monitor pitch + compass HUD
Long telephotos display WebGL Digital Crop vs Optical FOV indicator
Press Esc or Exit to restore your previous globe camera
chapters.example: Test 200mm portrait framing vs 24mm wide landscape cleanly in 3D.
chapters.issues: Terrain exaggeration restores cleanly when closing Viewfinder 3D.
chapters.limits: Extreme focal lengths are approximated within WebGL 18°-65° vertical FOV.

chapters.title: Time Machine Split Swipe & NASA EPIC Date Picker
chapters.purpose: Browse NASA GIBS archival layers, scrub split-date comparison, and inspect historical EPIC frames.
chapters.entry: Layers -> Earth Time Machine or NASA EPIC Earth.
steps: Pick a GIBS imagery product and Date A in Time Machine dock
Enable Dual-Date Compare, pick Date B, and drag split/mix slider
Pick custom dates in the EPIC modal with transparent nearest-date fallback
chapters.example: Compare spring snowmelt vs autumn coverage; unavailable EPIC dates fall back honestly.
chapters.issues: Dark orbital gaps occur naturally over cloudy or polar-night zones.
chapters.limits: NASA public imagery carries normal 6-24h orbital processing latency.

chapters.title: Four-Season Commons Gallery & Street View 2.0
chapters.purpose: Filter landscape Commons media by real EXIF season and hop through 360° Panoramax panoramas.
chapters.entry: Drawer Media Strip, Photo Gallery view, and Street View buttons.
steps: Filter gallery strip by Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter/Undated EXIF tags
Click photos to open lightbox with Wikimedia author & license credits
Use Compass Sync, Prev/Next hops, and Return to Spot in Street View
chapters.example: Rice terraces & wild ducks pass relevance scoring while restaurant dishes are filtered out.
chapters.issues: Undated images stay in "Undated" rather than inventing false seasonal tags.
chapters.limits: Falls back to geo-tagged Commons shots when no open street view covers remote peaks.

chapters.title: Trip Planner 2.0: Exact City Resolution & Draft Safety
chapters.purpose: Eliminate silent fallback mismatches with explicit draft locks and fuzzy suggestion picking.
chapters.entry: Click Trip Planner from top capsule or mobile navigation.
steps: Click "+ New Trip" for a clean draft and type origin & destination
Pick an exact match from the suggestion dropdown and inspect preview summary
Unknown queries display an explicit error instead of falling back silently
chapters.example: Typing "北京" resolves cn-beijing cleanly without ever reverting to a prior city.
chapters.issues: Ambiguous city names ask you to pick from top candidates.
chapters.limits: Auto-scheduling optimizes curated spots plus user-added custom pins.

chapters.title: 3-Tier Multimodal Transport: Flight, HSR, Rail, Ferry & Drive
chapters.purpose: Compare intercity flights/HSR/rail/ferry/drive, airport transfers, and city transit.
chapters.entry: Trip Planner -> Intercity selector and Transport/Route tab.
steps: Select preferred intercity mode and open Transport tab
Inspect nearest OurAirports gateways, great-circle distance, and rail operators
Review airport-to-downtown options and official booking/reference links
chapters.example: Beijing to Shanghai compares HSR (~5h city-center) vs flight (incl. airport transfer).
chapters.issues: Trans-oceanic pairs reject OSRM land routes and display honest great-circle arcs.
chapters.limits: Zero fabricated live flight numbers, train IDs, or ticket inventories.

chapters.title: Multi-City, Locked Stops, Calendar & Conflict Alerts
chapters.purpose: Lock must-keep reservations, toggle Timeline vs Calendar, and catch schedule conflicts.
chapters.entry: Trip Planner -> Itinerary Timeline tab.
steps: Toggle Lock on fixed stops (e.g., sunrise spot or hotel check-in)
Click Re-optimize Unlocked to reorder only flexible items cleanly
Switch between Timeline list and Day Calendar grid
Review automatic transfer and time-overlap conflict warnings
chapters.example: Lock dawn photo stop while optimizing midday cafe and temple stops.
chapters.issues: Re-optimization preserves relative order of all locked items.
chapters.limits: Verify special holiday closures on official venue websites.

chapters.title: 9-Category Multi-Currency Budget, FX & Prep Kit
chapters.purpose: Track est vs actual expenses across 9 categories, live FX rates, and country prep kits.
chapters.entry: Trip Planner -> Budget & FX and Prep Kit tabs.
steps: Review 9 expense categories (Est vs Actual) in Budget & FX tab
Switch currency and convert via Frankfurter FX (with offline fallback rate)
Check voltage/plug types, emergency numbers, and official embassy links in Prep Kit
chapters.example: Convert Tokyo trip budget to JPY and verify Japan plug Type A + 110/119 info.
chapters.issues: ECB FX rates refresh daily and serve as planning guidance only.
chapters.limits: Always confirm current visa rules via government or IATA links provided.

chapters.title: Optional Account Auth, Guest Mode & Safe Migration
chapters.purpose: Use KAIROS freely as a guest, or sign in for cross-device sync and safe archive import.
chapters.entry: Account icon pill in top navigation capsule.
steps: Email auth uses PBKDF2-SHA256 hashing and HttpOnly SameSite cookies
First login lets you back up and migrate guest data safely with full user isolation
Export all personal records or delete your cloud account permanently anytime
chapters.example: Guest trips and footprints merge cleanly into your newly registered account.
chapters.issues: If D1 backend is unconfigured, guest local mode continues seamlessly.
chapters.limits: Email verification & Google OAuth require deploying optional Worker secrets.

chapters.title: Multi-User Collaboration, RBAC & Team Polls
chapters.purpose: Share expiring invite codes, assign Owner/Editor/Viewer roles, comment, and vote.
chapters.entry: Trip Planner -> Collaboration & Split tab.
steps: Owner generates a time-limited invite code (Editor or Viewer) revocable anytime
Collaborators post comments, vote in polls, and inspect version snapshots
Concurrent edits converge deterministically via CRDT LWW + tombstones
chapters.example: 3 teammates vote on day-trip options and merge stops deterministically.
chapters.issues: Revoked members or Viewer roles cannot mutate shared trips on Worker API.
chapters.limits: Uses D1 sync + BroadcastChannel rather than paid WebSocket Durable Objects.

chapters.title: Group Expense Ledger & Minimum-Transfer Settlement
chapters.purpose: Log group expenses (equal or custom weights) and compute minimum settlement transfers.
chapters.entry: Trip Planner -> Collaboration & Split -> Expense Splitter.
steps: Add participants, pick the payer, and choose equal or weighted splits
Inspect net positive/negative balances for every member
Follow minimum-transfer settlement instructions and export CSV summary
chapters.example: 12 shared bills across 4 travelers settle cleanly in at most 3 transfers.
chapters.issues: Convert multi-currency expenses into a base currency before final settlement.
chapters.limits: Ledger/calculation tool only; zero financial payment or banking integration.

chapters.title: Private-by-Default Archive, Journals & EXIF Stripping
chapters.purpose: Track visited/planned/wishlist places, field journals, and EXIF-stripped photos privately.
chapters.entry: Click My Archive from top island or mobile nav.
steps: Archives default to private local IndexedDB storage
Photos undergo Canvas re-encoding to strip sensitive EXIF GPS coordinates
Log rich travel journals with dates, moods, 1-5★ ratings, and notes
chapters.example: Log journal notes locally with automatic GPS EXIF removal before cloud backup.
chapters.issues: Export backup JSON before clearing browser site data in guest mode.
chapters.limits: Cross-device photo blob sync requires binding an optional Cloudflare R2 bucket.

chapters.title: Footprint Globe Overlay & Annual Travel Report
chapters.purpose: Visualize explored countries on the 3D globe and generate ECharts annual stats.
chapters.entry: Archive -> Show on Globe or Annual Report Card button.
steps: Tag destinations as Visited, Planned, or Wishlist
Inspect lazy-loaded ECharts coverage & monthly stats
Generate high-DPI annual footprint posters or URL-encoded read-only links
chapters.example: Render golden globe markers and download a 9:16 annual summary poster.
chapters.issues: Serverless URL footprint links encode statuses compactly in URL params.
chapters.limits: Stats reflect only recorded trips, check-ins, and expenses.

chapters.title: 8 Open Export Formats (ICS, GPX, KML, GeoJSON, CSV, PDF)
chapters.purpose: Export itineraries into calendars, GPS devices, GIS tools, spreadsheets, and print PDFs.
chapters.entry: Trip Planner -> Export & Share buttons.
steps: ICS imports directly into Apple, Google, or Outlook Calendar
GPX 1.1, KML 2.2 & GeoJSON open in outdoor GPS apps & GIS software
BOM UTF-8 CSV opens cleanly in Excel; Print view creates clean PDF roadbooks
chapters.example: Download .gpx and .ics before departure for zero-network trail and calendar backups.
chapters.issues: If popups are blocked, PDF falls back cleanly to printable HTML download.
chapters.limits: Only stops with valid coordinates appear in spatial GPX/KML tracks.

chapters.title: Global Share Center, 6 Aspect Posters & Local QR Codes
chapters.purpose: Share 12 object types with 6 social ratios, web intents, and 100% local QR SVG.
chapters.entry: Share buttons across drawer, photo lab, planner, and archive.
steps: Choose from 6 aspect ratios tailored to Instagram, Stories, XHS, X, and WeChat
QR codes render locally in-browser as pure SVG with zero external tracking
Uses Web Share API, X/WhatsApp/Telegram intents, or Download Poster + Copy Caption
chapters.example: Export a 3:4 photo-window poster with scannable local QR back to the exact camera azimuth.
chapters.issues: Signed-in private share tokens can be revoked at any time.
chapters.limits: Platforms lacking open web-post APIs honestly use Poster + Caption + QR.

chapters.title: Deep-Link URLs & Legacy V4 Compatibility
chapters.purpose: Restore exact destination, spot, azimuth, date, active layers, and language via URL.
chapters.entry: Copied from Share Center or browser address bar.
steps: Supports ?focus=, ?spot=, ?cam=, ?date=, ?layers=, and ?lang=
Preserves 100% compatibility with legacy ?trip=, ?footprint=, and ?embed= links
chapters.example: Open deep-link parameters to jump straight to a curated camera angle and locale.
chapters.issues: Very large offline trips share best via signed-in invite links or JSON export.
chapters.limits: Stateless URL payloads stay bounded to safe browser URL lengths.

chapters.title: PWA App Install & Offline Travel Pack
chapters.purpose: Install KAIROS as a standalone app and cache destination packs cleanly for offline flights.
chapters.entry: Install App trigger (when eligible) and Offline Travel Pack button.
steps: Install KAIROS when your browser supports beforeinstallprompt or Add to Home Screen
Save Offline Travel Pack into IndexedDB with an explicit "Cached at ..." timestamp
Ephemeris solar/lunar tools, AA splitter, and saved packs run 100% offline
chapters.example: Save your Hokkaido trip pack before boarding to inspect sun azimuths mid-flight.
chapters.issues: Respects tile provider terms: never bulk-scrapes satellite map tiles.
chapters.limits: iOS Safari installs PWAs manually via Share -> Add to Home Screen.

chapters.title: 722 SEO City Pages & Embeddable Globe Widget
chapters.purpose: Use 722 static city cards (with 1200×630 OG PNG) and iframe globe embeds.
chapters.entry: Static paths /p/<city-id>.html or Embed snippet in Share Center.
steps: Copy customizable <iframe> embed code from Share Center
Use ?embed=<id>&chrome=off&spin=1 to embed minimalist rotating globes
chapters.example: Embed Kyoto with day/night terminator right inside Markdown/Notion/blogs.
chapters.issues: Auth and account endpoints enforce frame-ancestors none against clickjacking.
chapters.limits: Sandboxed iframes default to read-only guest visualization.

chapters.title: Seamless Simplified, Traditional Chinese & English UI
chapters.purpose: Switch dynamically across zh-CN, zh-TW, and en across every V5 module.
chapters.entry: Language pill in the top bar or ?lang= URL parameter.
steps: Toggle locale without losing active map view or trip state
zh-TW maps domain-accurate terminology cleanly
chapters.example: Add &lang=en to any link so international collaborators see native English UI.
chapters.issues: User-submitted Wikimedia photo titles retain original uploader language.
chapters.limits: Regional translation dictionaries load lazily per continent.

chapters.title: Diagnostics Console, 11-Service Health & Performance Tiers
chapters.purpose: Monitor upstream service circuit breakers, WebGL FPS, and clear stale caches safely.
chapters.entry: Layers popover -> Diagnostics button.
steps: Check worker proxy flags and API latency per upstream service
Throttle render quality tier on low-power devices
Clear API tile caches safely without wiping personal archives or trips
chapters.example: Verify tile CDN response health before choosing Auto/Mirror tile routing.
chapters.issues: Circuit breakers prevent retry storms during upstream rate limits.
chapters.limits: Health probes measure reachability from your live browser network.

chapters.title: Data Provenance, Open Licenses & Known Scientific Limits
chapters.purpose: Understand exact upstream data sources, licenses, modeling assumptions, and boundaries.
chapters.entry: In-app Help Center + repository docs/DATA_SOURCES.md & KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md.
steps: Weather: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0, capped at 14 days)
Astronomy: SunCalc & Astronomy Engine offline ephemeris
Earth/Media: NASA GIBS & EPIC, Panoramax, Wikimedia Commons
Routing/Hubs: OurAirports & OpenStreetMap / OSRM
chapters.example: Source badges across the UI always expose whether telemetry is live, orbital, or archive.
chapters.issues: Zero unauthorized scraping or paid commercial data simulation.
chapters.limits: No live commercial flight/rail ticketing inventory; intercity leg times are estimates.

chapters.title: Keyboard Shortcuts, Troubleshooting FAQ & Feedback
chapters.purpose: Look up keyboard shortcuts, debug common issues, and submit pre-filled GitHub feedback.
chapters.entry: Press ? anywhere or click the "?" Help button in top/workspace bars.
steps: Shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+K Search, ? Help Manual, Esc Close modals/viewfinder
Click "Report Issue" in Help Center to open a sanitized GitHub Issue template
chapters.example: Report missing spot notes via the privacy-safe pre-filled GitHub Issue button.
chapters.issues: Feedback never transmits personal tokens, coordinates, or local photos.
chapters.limits: Submitting a GitHub Issue requires internet connectivity.
